about: The agent registry (mappingLayers ML1-b; SPEC §7, D-AUTHOR ruled): one row per author, registrar or submitter a layer names. A person is edc:agent/<educore userRefId>, never a username; raters stay pseudonymous; orcid and ror are optional aliases. Read by lib/layer-registry/layerRegistry.js, which refuses an agent a layer names that is not here.
